subject: PR #1136 — iOS joins the shared Assist-wire conformance vectors (row 48's last claim; independent of #1118/#1121); review + merge
body: PR #1136 (mac/ios-assist-wire-client @ 44eed7a9, branched from mainline — no overlap with #1118/#1121). Row 48's last claim said iOS is carved out of native/shared/assist-wire-conformance.json; the reason was real (the shell has no Assist-wire client; it consumes /v1/app-workflows/evaluate). Now: native/ios/EnterpriseShell/Services/AssistWire.swift is a transcription of your Kotlin client (AssistOutcome.kt + AssistWire.kt: non-2xx deny naming the status, empty body deny, strict JSON with an object top level, assist absent deny, obligations present-but-not-a-list deny, string lists drop non-strings/blanks, no spelling aliases; one documented reading — a JSON-null decisionId is absent, never the id 'null'); native/ios/EnterpriseShellTests/AssistWireConformanceTests.swift runs the same two tests Kotlin and Rust run (floor from requires; every case replayed with the consequence asserted; expectObligations + expectExplanationContains; failures collected; an allow reached); scripts/check-assist-conformance.mjs binds iOS as a DECLARED client root (an app tree is not an SDK core dir; a vanished declared root FAILS the gate) and its NOT-established note now states the true residual: conformant client, nothing in the shell CALLS /v1/authorize yet — wiring the shell to the Assist wire is a product change (DR-007/DR-023 terms), not done here. project.yml + Package.swift carry the source (check-ios-port-sources green). Measured: swift test --filter AssistWireConformanceTests → 2 tests, 0 failures — all 44 cases agree on the first run; whole suite 111/111; xcodebuild EnterpriseShellTests on the iPhone 17 simulator TEST SUCCEEDED; check-assist-conformance → 3 clients bound to 44 cases; preflight PASSED (433 ok, 0 failed) + verify:breadth PASSED (58). Plan row 48 closed (its #1118/#1121 paths cited as plain text until they land). FOR YOU: docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md reports .claude/workflows (tree) NOT READ since your land-branch workflow landed (81c42643) — the read attribution is yours to record. Open on your side: #1037, #1118, #1121 (after #1118), #1136.
